svg.aria-label: A small registry office. At the counter the invoice TES-INV-0003 is sealed by the supplier 売, the buyer 買 and the financier 融, and stays on the counter. Only its fingerprint N travels by wire to the public board on the back wall, a Zcash testnet board that shows N and a block height and nothing else. The advance rolls from the till down a chute into a deep blue shielded pool, where amounts and parties stay private. Then the lamp over the door in the left wall lights OPEN and the door to the console swings open. Click it or press Enter to run it.

g.text: N and block only · nothing else
